体育馆里的课桌排到了看不见的地方。成绩环在舞台上空旋转，每一次批改，都抹去一个名: Desks stretch beyond sight inside the gym. Rings of grades turn above the stage. Each correction erases another name.
再好一点。第一。满分。不能失败。: A little better. First place. Full marks. I must not fail.
它说话的时候……为什么听起来这么累。: Why does it sound... so tired when it speaks?
这些声音没有唯一来源。是所有人的期待，挤成了一个轮廓。: These voices have no single source. Everyone's expectations have been pressed into one shape.
别被它的节奏带走。三秒红色预警，先看站位，再决定治疗或撤退。: Don't follow its rhythm. The red warning lasts three seconds. Check positions, then decide whether to heal or retreat.
如果撑不住，就告诉我。: Tell me if you can't hold on.
出口的灯还亮着。我在这里等你们。: The exit light is still on. I'll wait here for you.
我们不是来交一张满分答卷。我们来把大家带回去。: We're not here to hand in a perfect paper. We're here to bring everyone home.
最后一片影子散开时，走廊尽头终于传来了真实的脚步声。: As the last shadow scatters, real footsteps finally sound at the end of the corridor.
……结束了。你没受伤吧？: ...It's over. You're not hurt, are you?
我叫它们残响。不是每天都会出现，也不是所有人都看得见。: I call them Echoes. They don't appear every day, and not everyone can see them.
我只是碰了一下墙，就让那个光点留住了。: I only touched the wall, and that point of light stayed there.
你留下的位置，让我能站稳。刚才没有它，我得一直后退。: The position you left let me hold my ground. Without it, I'd have had to keep falling back.
她把刀收回剑袋，才发现握袋带的手还没有完全放松。: She returns her sword to its bag, then realizes her hand still hasn't relaxed around the strap.
雨宫澪，剑道部。明天……如果又听见不对劲的声音，别一个人过去。: Mio Amamiya. Kendo Club. Tomorrow... if you hear something strange again, don't go alone.
{player}。新转来的。看来还有很多事情要补课。: {player}. I just transferred here. Looks like I have a lot to catch up on.
先把今天的路走出去吧。校门真的在这次的尽头。: Let's find our way out of today first. The school gate really is at the end this time.
刚才最外侧还有一个。已经散了。: There was one more at the far edge. It's gone now.
看见走廊的影子变长，就过来了。: I came when I saw the shadows in the corridor getting longer.
听起来，你不是第一次遇见这些。: Sounds like this isn't your first time seeing them.
嗯。只是以前没找到能留下来的坐标。: No. I just never found a coordinate that would stay before.
所以你一直只在远处看着？: So you always watched from a distance?
有时候。我在想，是不是看清楚就足够了。今天看来不够。: Sometimes. I wondered whether seeing clearly was enough. Today proved it wasn't.
他把箭袋背好，目光停在你刚才留下的光点上。: He shoulders his quiver, his eyes resting on the light you left behind.

窗玻璃映出一张空白试卷。纸面上浮出一道红痕，又在下一秒被擦掉。: A blank exam paper appears in the window's reflection. A red mark rises on its surface, then is erased a moment later.
停下。别往那个声音来的方向走。: Stop. Don't go toward that sound.
一名抱着剑袋的学生挡在楼梯前。她头侧的花饰，在突然暗下来的走廊里留着一点白。: A student carrying a sword bag blocks the stairs. The flower in her hair holds a trace of white in the suddenly dim corridor.
你也发现这里一直在重复？: You noticed it keeps repeating, too?
嗯。你看得见它们……先别问。站到我身后。: Yes. You can see them... Questions later. Get behind me.
纸页翻动的声音从没有人的教室里响起。你的指尖触到墙面，一点微光沿地板延伸，停在她: Pages rustle in an empty classroom. Your fingers touch the wall. A glimmer stretches across the floor and stops at her feet.
这个坐标……能稳定下来。保持住它，我来拦住前面的东西。: This coordinate... it can stabilize. Hold it there. I'll stop what's coming.
夕阳仍挂在窗外。走廊里，第一声剑鸣划开了凝固的放学后。: The sunset still hangs beyond the windows. In the corridor, the first ring of a sword cuts through the frozen after-school hour.
用发光坐标部署雨宫澪，阻挡正面残响。守住防线并清除全部敌人。: Deploy Mio Amamiya at a glowing coordinate to block incoming Echoes. Hold the line and defeat every enemy.
无名优等生有三个阶段。红色错题预警持续3秒，可撤退或用治疗应对；核心被Boss触: The Nameless Honor Student has three phases. Red warning zones last 3s: retreat or heal through them. If the Boss reaches the core, you lose.
三路残响即将协同接近。保留悠真的破空箭清理密集目标；受压时治疗，或撤退后换线再部: Echoes are approaching together across three lanes. Save Yuma's Sky-Piercing Arrow for dense groups. Heal under pressure, or retreat and redeploy to another lane.
本关新敌人：疾走残响体——移动速度是普通残响体的近两倍: New enemy: Rushing Echo. Moves almost twice as fast as a Common Echo.
疾走残响体从右侧入口冲到防线只需约 2 秒：请提前判断它走哪一路: A Rushing Echo takes about 2s from the right entrance to your line. Watch its lane in advance.
雨宫澪只能守一条路线；两路同时来敌时，先保威胁最大的那一路: Mio can hold only one lane. If enemies approach in two, protect the greater threat first.
漏怪会直接扣核心生命；三路共享同一个残响锚点: Enemies that slip through damage the core directly. All three lanes share one Echo Anchor.
疾走残响会迅速通过空线。留意下一波路线，提前安排阻挡与部署。: Rushing Echoes cross empty lanes quickly. Watch the next wave's lanes and prepare your blockers before it arrives.
神谷悠真加入：远程输出，射程 4.0 格，但无法阻挡敌人: Yuma Kamiya joins: ranged damage with 4.0-tile range, but cannot block enemies.
试卷飞灵会停在远处攻击：前线的射程够不到它，必须用远程反击: Exam Wraiths stop at a distance to attack. Frontline attacks cannot reach them; use ranged support.
把悠真放在前线身后：他的射程能覆盖整条路线，越靠后越安全: Place Yuma behind your frontline. His range covers the lane, and farther back is safer.
两名角色覆盖不了三条路线：优先守住压力最大的那一路: Two characters cannot cover three lanes. Prioritize the lane under the most pressure.
试卷飞灵不能被近战阻挡。神谷悠真从后方攻击自己的路线与相邻路线。: Exam Wraiths cannot be blocked in melee. Yuma attacks his own and adjacent lanes from behind.
本关新敌人：装甲残响体——防御极高，生命 800: New enemy: Armored Echo. Extremely high DEF and 800 HP.
装甲残响体：物理伤害会被高防御大幅削减，单人很难打死: High DEF greatly reduces physical damage. A single character struggles against an Armored Echo.
应对办法是集火：把前线与远程放在同一条路线一起打它: Focus your fire: put frontline and ranged characters in the same lane.
装甲残响体推进很慢（0.35 格/秒），可以先把别路的敌人处理完再回来: Armored Echoes move slowly (0.35 tiles/s). You can clear another lane first, then return.
装甲残响防御较高。前线承压时保持后方输出，留意澪的生命与再部署冷却。: Armored Echoes have high DEF. Keep firing from behind while the frontline holds. Watch Mio's HP and redeployment cooldown.
本关没有治疗角色：前线的生命无法恢复，请尽量减少她挨打的时间: There is no healer this stage. Minimize the time your frontline spends taking damage.
监考者：第一章的精英敌人。它的「注视」会降低被标记角色的攻击速度: The Invigilator is Chapter One's elite enemy. Its Gaze reduces the marked character's attack speed.
上路也有残响接近。中路悠真可以支援旁路；破空箭能够贯穿本路与相邻路线，留给残响密: Echoes approach the upper lane, too. Yuma in the middle can support adjacent lanes. Save his piercing arrow for dense groups.
监考者的生命低于 40% 后会加速：最后阶段请保持集火，不要让它堆在防线上: Below 40% HP, the Invigilator speeds up. Keep focus fire in the final phase; don't let enemies pile up at your line.
出战角色：雨宫澪与神谷悠真；本关没有治疗角色。: Available characters: Mio Amamiya and Yuma Kamiya. No healer this stage.
监考者：注视（每 10 秒标记最近角色 5 秒，攻速 -25%）与时间到（HP<: Invigilator: Gaze (every 10s, marks the nearest character for 5s, attack speed -25%); Time's Up (below 40% HP, movement +30%).
监考者的注视会拖慢角色攻击，低生命时会加速。处理杂兵并在首次三选一中选择适合阵容: The Invigilator's Gaze slows attacks, and it accelerates at low HP. Clear its escorts and choose an upgrade that fits your team.
结衣的治疗跨越相邻路线。焦虑领域降低攻速和技能恢复，让结衣守在澪身后。: Yui heals across adjacent lanes. Anxiety fields slow attacks and skill recovery. Keep Yui behind Mio.
排名幽灵每8秒削弱范围内攻击最高的角色。凛负责资源调度，悠真兼顾旁路。: Every 8s, Ranking Phantoms weaken the ally with the highest ATK in range. Rin manages resources; Yuma covers the side lanes.
沉默只封锁主动技能。纱良用特殊伤害处理装甲，并用实验装置短暂补住旁路。: Silence blocks only active skills. Sara's special damage counters armor, and her device can briefly hold a side lane.
作弊纸偶低生命时分裂一次。先处理远程与排名幽灵，为体育馆调查做好准备。: Cheating Paper Dolls split once at low HP. Clear ranged enemies and Ranking Phantoms to prepare for the gym investigation.
点击底部角色卡，再点战场格子部署角色: Click a character card below, then a battlefield tile to deploy.
敌人从右侧「入口」出现，沿三条路线向左推进: Enemies enter from the right and advance left along three lanes.
三条路线共用同一个「残响锚点」；核心生命归零即失败: All lanes share one Echo Anchor. If its HP reaches zero, you lose.
部署消耗 AP；AP 每秒自然回复 1 点，上限 30: Deployment costs AP. Recover 1 AP per second, up to 30.
前线负责阻挡：把敌人拦在格子前，让它停下来打你: Frontline characters block enemies at their tile, forcing them to stop and fight.
远程负责攻击：站在前线身后，射程内持续输出: Ranged characters attack from behind the frontline, dealing damage within range.
治疗负责恢复：范围内生命百分比最低的受伤友军优先: Healers prioritize wounded allies with the lowest HP percentage in range.
点击场上角色可打开操作面板主动撤退；撤退返还 50% AP，但需等 20 秒再部: Click a deployed character to retreat. Refunds 50% AP, with a 20s redeployment cooldown.
